The material may be incomplete or truncated; use uncertain where warranted. For each additional factual assertion actually made in the answer outside the expected claims, return {assertion, answer_quote, status, reason, citations}; status is supported, contradicted, or unverifiable, and citations quote only the supplied source evidence. The source evidence covers only cited expected-claim sources and is partial; absence is unverifiable, never contradicted. Contradicted requires direct contrary source evidence. Do not add requirements for facts the user did not ask for or penalize omitted assertions. Citation quote and answer_quote must be exact substrings of their material.
